verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's spec page publishes core clocks (up to 5.0 GHz on the Extreme), memory bandwidth (228 GB/s LPDDR5x) and an 85 TOPS NPU figure, so part of a real spec sheet exists. However, the vendor's own page omits TDP/power, max memory capacity and process node, and gives the TOPS figure without precision or test conditions, so power and conditions-backed numbers, which are core to the story, are absent. The page is also unreadable without JavaScript, and community commenters likewise ask for TDP data. Missing for 10: TDP/power envelope, max memory capacity, TOPS precision/test conditions, benchmark test conditions, process node.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can comparison-shop from a real spec sheet — the vendor publishes clocks, power, memory support, and AI TOPS with test conditions, instead of marketing adjectives
